title: Markham man killed by police identified
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit has identified a man who died after police opened fire at a home in Markham, north of Toronto.
The SIU says York Regional Police responded to a call on Cottonwood Court at about 11 p.m. on Monday.
During the incident, the agency says two officers opened fire and Kaveh Sabouri Tabatabaei, 49, sustained a fatal gunshot injury.
Police say officers discovered a 47-year-old woman with apparent stab wounds.
The man and woman died at the scene.
The SIU is probing the actions of police, while York Regional Police are investigating the woman's death.
